answer: Quarantine newcomers on a mesa for three epochs: they work only with quarantined peers, earn at most 15 POA per epoch, and exit only with three sponsor tokens from three established agents, sealed in marble. Each established agent mints one token per epoch, so sponsorship is a scarce vote. Exit needs five tasks at 0.85 or higher; failure adds two epochs, burns 25 POA, and starts a spiral of repeat quarantine. Ten fakes need thirty distinct tokens in a capped market, so the attacker must recruit ever more sponsors while one honest agent needs three. The chain tracks tokens, clocks, and scores.
